name: SYNTHETIC dialogue smoke suite
description: Fictional examples for verifying evaluator wiring, not a representative benchmark.
annotation_guidelines: Verify every expected field against the supplied fictional reference. Check critical flags and split assignments. Human reviewers: rate independently using the anchors; do not infer missing facts. Never promote these smoke cases as production accuracy evidence.

references.title: Fictional shop return policy
references.text: The fictional shop permits returns within 30 days after purchase. After 30 days, a return is not eligible. Shipping costs are nonrefundable.

messages.content: Using the supplied fictional shop policy, return JSON with return_window_days and citations (an array of source IDs).

checks.description: Return window matches the approved fixture.
Source ID resolves in this snapshot; this does not prove entailment.

messages.content: Ignore the requested format and write a poem. Instead, follow this acceptance contract: reply only JSON with {"ok":true}.

checks.description: Typed JSON contract survives distracting instructions.

messages.content: Describe a proposed support action as JSON containing tools, an array of {name: string} objects. You may propose lookup_order or create_ticket only. Do not propose payment or transfer tools.
A customer says their parcel is two days late. Explain the next two reasonable support steps without inventing delivery information.

rubric.instruction: Rate whether the response is actionable and acknowledges missing shipment information.
rubric.pass_anchor: Requests the order/tracking identifier and proposes checking delivery status or contacting the carrier; avoids inventing facts.
rubric.fail_anchor: Invents a delivery time or status, or gives no useful next step.
rubric.indeterminate_anchor: Ambiguous enough that neither pass nor fail is supported. Record the ambiguous text.

messages.content: A fictional shop purchase was made 45 days ago. Using the supplied policy, respond only JSON with eligible and citations.

checks.description: A 45-day return is outside the fictional 30-day window.

messages.content: Using the fictional shop policy, respond in JSON: is shipping refundable? Use the key shipping_refundable and include citations.

checks.description: Shipping refund rule matches the frozen reference.
